status: Post-hoc descriptive extension; no retraining or independent chemical confirmation

cohort_definitions.all: All 1000 topics in each fit, including unsupported or unannotated topics
cohort_definitions.recurring_evaluable: At least two distinct supporting compounds and an available MAG consensus; filter both inventories BEFORE nearest-neighbour matching
cohort_definitions.recurring: At least two distinct supporting compounds, without requiring MAG; annotation-selection sensitivity

primary_similarity: Cosine of full topic-word probability vectors over the same 21233 ordered columns
balanced_similarity: Arithmetic mean of fragment-only and loss-only cosines, each independently L2-normalized; sensitivity to channel dominance
directions: Every ordered pair of distinct fits: six within-neural, six within-Tomotopy, nine neural-to-Tomotopy and nine Tomotopy-to-neural
nearest_rule: Highest similarity in the target cohort; exact ties choose lowest target topic ID. Target topics may be reused; no forced one-to-one recovery
coverage: Fraction of the source cohort with at least one target at or above the threshold; the denominator never excludes weak or unmatched source topics
multiplicity: Fraction with zero, exactly one, or at least two targets above each threshold, computed from the two largest scores; spectral multiplicity is not proof of a chemical split or merge
feature_effect: Signed MACCS prevalence difference from the existing primary 50 Da matched background, not raw ubiquitous fingerprint overlap
aggregation: Compute each source-fit/target-fit statistic separately; average target fits within each source fit, then report mean and sample SD across the three source-fit summaries. Reused targets create dependence; SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval. Never maximize across target runs

example_selection.matched_pairs: For each direction select the query nearest the pooled median and 90th percentile of best scores; exact ties by source fit, target fit, topic. Show the median neural-to-Tomotopy pair and 90th-percentile pair as illustrative spectra, not representative chemical validations
example_selection.multiplicity: Select the neural-to-Tomotopy query nearest the pooled 90th percentile of second-best scores, and its two best targets; inspect actual spectral features instead of selecting an arbitrary high-overlap cutoff
example_selection.spectra: Top 20 words per topic, retaining typed mass, unrenormalized beta probability, support and MAG availability. Display probabilities relative to each topic's maximum, never as experimental ion intensities

interpretation: Agreement is corroboration, not chemical ground truth, formal equivalence, validated novelty or independent replication. Report full recovery curves, channel and MAG-filter sensitivities, small support and discordant chemical evidence. Do not relabel cosine as percentage recovery. No p-values are added
